sources.title: GitHub - mamad8c/ComfyUI-H3-Latent-Upscaler-Mamad8
sources.snippet: Two minimal ComfyUI nodes for the Mamad8 MiniMax H3 clean-latent 2× upscaler. The model doubles the spatial dimensions of a fully denoised MiniMax H3 video latent while keeping its temporal length unchanged. When the input is H3's joint video/audio latent, the node changes only the video stream and preserves the audio stream.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 2x Latent Upscaler With ComfyUI Nodes
sources.snippet: Mamad8 releases a 2x clean-latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 with two ComfyUI nodes, doubling spatial resolution before VAE decode while staying in latent space.
